history.title: From a workshop to an art and antiques dealer on eBay
history.imageAlt: James Rizzi artwork From New York to Heidelberg
paragraphs: Wolfgang Kolb began dealing in antiques in 1984. What started as a one-man business developed over four decades into an art and antiques dealer with an international buying audience.

The turning point came in the early 2000s: as one of the first antiques dealers in Germany, we recognised the potential of eBay. Under the username “Kurprinz”, we built an international audience — today with more than 50,000 followers.
Today, a team of art historians, photographers and logistics specialists works to market more than 15,000 collectables per month professionally — from Ulm to the world.

detail.title: Five steps to a successful sale

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Send us photos and a brief description of your collectables — by email, phone or WhatsApp. A personal appointment on site is also possible.
steps.detail: We will get back to you within 48 hours.

steps.title: Valuation & advice
steps.text: Our art historians assess your collectables and give you a realistic price range. The professional assessment is free and non-binding.

steps.title: Consignment
steps.text: Bring your collectables to us or use our collection service — throughout Germany and within the EU.
steps.detail: All collectables are inventoried and securely documented.

steps.title: Professional preparation
steps.text: Every piece is professionally photographed in our studio, described from an art-historical perspective and listed on eBay — visible to more than 50,000 followers.
steps.detail: Multiple perspectives, detail shots, calibrated colours.

steps.title: Sale & payout
steps.text: We handle packaging, shipping and customer service. You receive your proceeds within 22 working days — with a detailed statement.

header.title: Frequently asked questions
header.text: Here you will find answers to the most important questions about selling your art and antiques with Kolb Antik.

items.q: How long does the whole process take?
items.a: From consignment to sale, the process usually takes around 14 days. Larger collections may take a little longer — we will keep you informed transparently about the schedule.

items.q: When will I receive my money?
items.a: Payout is made within 22 working days after the auction ends. You receive a detailed statement for all sold collectables.
Yes, we are happy to buy directly, in cash and at any scale. Simply contact us for a non-binding offer.

items.q: Why do you work on eBay without a minimum selling price?
items.a: Auctions without a reserve generally attract more bidders and create more competition. This usually leads to better final prices than auctions with a high starting price. For collectables where a limit should be set, we offer online art auctions through international auction platforms.

items.q: Do you sell only through eBay?

items.q: Do you offer a collection service?
items.a: Yes, for larger collections or bulky collectables we offer a collection service within Germany and the EU.

We accept art, antiques, collectables, jewellery, silver, porcelain, glass, watches, varia, entire collections and estates. If you are unsure, please contact us — we will give you a professional assessment.
Yes, the initial valuation is free and non-binding. You can then decide at your own pace whether you would like to work with us.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: Responsible for data processing on this website:

sections.title: 2. General information
paragraphs: We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This website uses no cookies, no tracking tools and no external services (such as Google Analytics, Google Fonts or social media plugins).
All content — including fonts and icons — is served directly from our own server. No data is transferred to third parties when you visit our website.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and server log files
paragraphs: When you visit our website, technical information is automatically stored in server log files:
sections.afterList: This data cannot be assigned to specific persons and is used exclusively to ensure operation and to troubleshoot errors. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest).

sections.title: 4. Contact form and email contact
paragraphs: If you contact us via the contact form, by email, phone or WhatsApp, the data you provide (e.g. name, email address, phone number, message) will be stored and used by us to process your enquiry.
The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to your enquiry).
Your data will not be passed on to third parties and will be deleted once the enquiry has been fully processed — unless statutory retention periods prevent deletion.
